- Day 2 (cutoff): execute DocuSign + confirm provisioning kickoff.

- Ben: confirm MSA/contract routing with legal & estimate time-to-sign for the countersign.
- Monica: confirm Dedicated capacity start date and any provisioning notes that need to be included in the SOW.
- Rachel: update HubSpot deal stage to Commit — add expected PO date and attach MAP.

I've attached the working MAP and the updated quote (pdf). Sarah — looping you for visibility. If procurement needs a consolidated PO template, please flag.

I'll run a 15-minute standup at 10:00 PT tomorrow for blockers. If anything looks like it will miss the window, call it out now so we can escalate.
